capability: Map classic TIFF IFD metadata and grayscale strip ownership, including aliases and out-of-file evidence.
user: Image ingestion maintainers investigating a small grayscale TIFF.
pain: Offset/count arrays and inline fields can conceal metadata/strip collisions before pixel decoding.
contract: Classic TIFF II/MM version42. At most32 acyclic word-aligned IFDs,128 fields per IFD; known field types1..12 have bounded payload extents and inline values up to4 bytes. Width/height, explicit8-bit samples, compression1, grayscale photometric0/1, one sample and contiguous planar layout. Explicit rows-per-strip and exact offset/count array sizes, including final partial strip. Expected raw bytes equal width times strip rows. Strip/strip and strip/metadata overlaps are exit1 findings with no winner policy; exact aliases remain visible.
limits: 8 MiB, width/height/rows1..1000000,4096 decoded values per interpreted tag,4096 strips total, first256 overlaps retained plus omitted count. No BigTIFF, compression, tiles, SubIFDs, color images, pixel decoding, orientation transforms, GeoTIFF/OME interpretation, metadata cleanup or full baseline TIFF conformance validation. Metadata/metadata aliases are not classified.
acceptance: Both endians, inline/out-of-line arrays, partial strips, exact aliases, metadata collisions, IFD cycles, bad counts/bounds and explicit unsupported format refusal.
notes: Sharp and libvips are broader processing/conversion libraries. Tifffile already exposes data offsets/bytecounts and supports far more TIFF variants. Issue333 about inline ASCII offsets informed careful field storage tests; it is adjacent evidence, not verified demand or a claim that current alternatives lack this capability.
overlap: Owned png-metadata-scrub edits PNG ancillary chunks. This TIFF project reads IFD/strip ownership under a different binary contract and does not edit files.
expected: Exit0: a2x2 invented image has one strip at bytes122..126 with no ownership overlaps.
